description: A multi-platform code generation system that converts JSON Schemas into typed class files across multiple programming languages using a shared core engine and extensible plugin architecture.

desktopApp.role: Visual, user-friendly interface for managing schemas, configuring projects, and previewing generated code.

features.schemaManagement: Import, edit, preview, and organize JSON Schemas.
features.batchGeneration: Generate classes for multiple languages at once.

architecturalRole: Front-end orchestrator delegating to core engine

cli.role: Automation layer for CI/CD, scripting, and power users.
features: Generate classes from JSON Schemas via command
cli.architecturalRole: Automation interface using the same core engine as the desktop app.

responsibilities: Map schema definitions to language constructs
Load and orchestrate language generator plugins

pluginSystem.description: Extensible architecture allowing new language generators without modifying Structogen.

projectFile.purpose: Defines how code should be generated.

steps: User creates or imports JSON Schemas
Files are written to output structure

separationOfConcerns.coreEngine: Schema parsing, generation logic, plugin orchestration
